page.overview:
What is Ashnod's Cylix?

Ashnod's Cylix was a counterfit version of the Golgothian Sylex.

Ashnod brought it with her to Argoth during the Invasion of Argoth, along with the real sylex. The cylix did not have the power of the original but was used to fool the Brotherhood of Gix, who craved the sylex even as Mishra himself refused it.

Although a counterfeit Sylex was later said to have been created by Ashnod from the hollowed-out skull of the Qadir of the Fallaji Empire, whom Ashnod killed during the Fall of Kroog, the cylix was actually created by more traditional means - coppersmithing, which Ashnod had taught herself during her years in exile.
